skills.implementation: PNG-tuber emotes, blinks and expression frames

skills.name: Icon and Micro-Sprite Suite
skills.description: Creates tiny items, status icons, inventory art, map markers, cursors, and low-resolution animated symbols.
skills.implementation: tiny icons and cursors at low resolution

skills.name: Cinematic Previsualization Sprite Suite
skills.description: Creates storyboard sprites, pose keys, effect layers, camera thumbnails, and timing sheets for later video work.
skills.implementation: storyboard and timing sheets for previz

skills.name: Text-to-Sprite Director
skills.description: Turns a written brief into a structured sprite plan and stable visual outputs with controlled variants.
skills.implementation: written brief parsed into a structured sprite plan

skills.name: Image-to-Sprite Converter
skills.description: Turns photos, drawings, renders, or concept art into clean sprites while keeping the main design readable.
skills.implementation: photo/drawing keyed out into a clean sprite

skills.name: Multi-Image Fusion Builder
skills.description: Combines approved parts from several references into one new sprite without carrying over accidental style conflicts.
skills.implementation: approved parts composited into one new sprite

skills.name: Sketch-to-Sheet Builder
skills.description: Turns rough sketches into cleaned views, action poses, frames, and packed sheets.

skills.name: Video-to-Sprite Extractor
skills.description: Selects useful frames from video, removes the background, stabilizes the subject, reduces the frame set, and packs a sheet.
skills.implementation: useful frames selected from video, extracted and packed

skills.name: Sprite-to-Video Previewer
skills.description: Turns sprite actions into clean preview videos with labels, speed choices, background choices, and side-by-side comparisons.
skills.implementation: sprite actions rendered to GIF/APNG previews with labels

skills.name: Depth and Normal Map Generator
skills.description: Creates depth, normal, emission, mask, and material helper maps for lit 2D or 2.5D workflows.

skills.name: Prompt and Seed Librarian
skills.description: Stores prompt parts, negative rules, seeds, reference weights, and successful settings for repeatable generation.
skills.implementation: generation settings recorded as versions

skills.name: Human Review Package Builder

skills.name: Originality and Similarity Reviewer
skills.description: Checks whether new sprites are too close to protected or supplied designs and recommends safer design changes.
skills.implementation: perceptual similarity screen against protected designs

skills.name: License and Attribution Manager
skills.description: Tracks licenses for models, textures, fonts, brushes, references, and generated assets and prepares needed credits.
skills.implementation: licence rollup with credits output

skills.name: Change Request Translator
skills.description: Turns reviewer comments into exact frame, layer, color, timing, and export tasks.
skills.implementation: reviewer notes parsed into frame/layer/colour/timing tasks

skills.name: Production Estimate Builder
skills.description: Estimates frame count, sheet count, review rounds, storage, and work stages from the requested action list.
skills.implementation: frames, sheets, review rounds and storage estimate
